import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from subject import (
    ModelShadowReviewCandidate,
    ModelShadowReviewPolicy,
    ModelShadowSelection,
    EnumShadowDecision,
    EnumShadowStratum,
    select_candidates,
    stratum_of,
    disqualification,
)


def _make_candidate(
    key="pr-1",
    repo="public-repo",
    title="feat: add feature",
    author="alice",
    author_is_bot=False,
    watcher_class="normal",
    evidence_companion=False,
    created_at=None,
):
    if created_at is None:
        created_at = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return ModelShadowReviewCandidate(
        key=key,
        repo=repo,
        title=title,
        author=author,
        author_is_bot=author_is_bot,
        watcher_class=watcher_class,
        evidence_companion=evidence_companion,
        created_at=created_at,
    )


def _make_policy(
    public_repos=None,
    private_repos=None,
    excluded_repos=None,
    companion_authors=None,
    window_start=None,
    public_cap=60,
    max_reviews_per_tick=10,
):
    if public_repos is None:
        public_repos = frozenset()
    if private_repos is None:
        private_repos = frozenset()
    if excluded_repos is None:
        excluded_repos = frozenset()
    if companion_authors is None:
        companion_authors = frozenset()
    return ModelShadowReviewPolicy(
        public_repos=public_repos,
        private_repos=private_repos,
        excluded_repos=excluded_repos,
        companion_authors=companion_authors,
        window_start=window_start,
        public_cap=public_cap,
        max_reviews_per_tick=max_reviews_per_tick,
    )
